title: Rav Chilkiyah son of Rav Avya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Bava Metzia 96b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.96b.15-16), raising an objection to Rava.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara names Rav Chilkiyah son of Rav Avya, as does [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1339&lang=en). The question concerns an animal weakened through labor. The sentence does not name the addressee. Hyman gives Rava.
